title: Add a Frozen-Backbone Adaptation Module
summary: A small residual adapter can learn a correction while a useful pretrained map stays fixed.

frames: Declared normalized action/feature coordinates; no implicit frame conversion

units.values: Token features and normalized actions are dimensionless; no world-frame transform or physical actuation is performed.

physical_contract.axes: Explicit token, batch and feature axes defined in the contract
physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: Each batch row is a synchronized caller-supplied policy context; group order is explicit.
physical_contract.batching: Explicit token, batch and feature axes defined in the contract

provenance.authoring_notes: Original linear residual-adapter training step motivated by adapting generalist policies while freezing pretrained weights; this is not Octo official fine-tuning code or a full parameter-efficient method.
